topic: The Brachistochrone Problem: The Race of Curves

sections.title: The Hook: Defining the Challenge
lecture_lines: A bead slides under gravity from A to B.
Which path takes the shortest time?
Compare the straight line against a curve.

lecture_lines: Distance alone does not define time.

sections.title: The Solution: The Cycloid
lecture_lines: The Brachistochrone curve is a cycloid.
Traced by a point on a rolling circle.
It balances distance and speed perfectly.
Accelerate rapidly, then cruise to B.
This is the fastest possible path.

Show the cycloid equation: x = r(θ - sinθ), y = r(1 - cosθ). (Color: #F1C40F)

lecture_lines: Calculus of Variations found the solution.
Time is independent of start point.
